name: ashroot_animist_shares_its_power_and_trample
notes: M4 mapper. Printed: 'Trample. Whenever this creature attacks, another target creature you control gains trample and gets +X/+X until end of turn, where X is this creature's power.' Ashroot Animist has a +1/+1 counter (5/5). It attacks with seat 0's Bear and targets the Bear: +5/+5 (7/7) and trample. Seat 1's 1/1 Cub blocks the Bear: 1 is lethal to it, 6 trample over (the division gives the Cub 1); the Animist is unblocked: seat 1 takes 5 + 6 = 11.
